# TopLine Exteriors LLC

> Licensed & insured roofing, deck, and siding contractor serving Bucks County, PA, Philadelphia, and South Jersey. Own crews, no subcontractors. Free estimates on all projects.

TopLine Exteriors LLC (PA HIC #PA214414) is a home exterior contractor specializing in roofing, deck & fence construction, and siding, serving Levittown, Bristol, Newtown, Yardley, Doylestown, and Langhorne, PA; Philadelphia, PA; and Cherry Hill, Trenton, and Camden, NJ.

## Services

- [Roofing](https://www.toplineexteriorsllc.com/roofing): Roof replacement, repair, asphalt shingle, metal, flat/low-slope roofing, storm damage inspection, gutters & gutter guards.
- [Decks & Fencing](https://www.toplineexteriorsllc.com/decks): Custom deck construction, deck restoration & refinishing, composite decking, wood decking, railings & guardrails, fencing, deck repair & structural reinforcement.
- [Siding](https://www.toplineexteriorsllc.com/siding): Siding replacement, vinyl siding, James Hardie fiber-cement siding, insulated siding, wood & cedar shake siding, siding repair, soffit/fascia/trim.
